panels.title: Hosts
panels.description: One row per enrolled host of the chosen type that sent data in the last 24 h, grouped by rack. Empty cells: the host has no such hardware.

targets.expr: ((time() - max by (host) (last_over_time(node_time_seconds{scope="infra"}[24h]))) < bool 120) and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(infra_host_info{scope="infra",type=~"$type"}[24h]))
(max by (host) (node_time_seconds{scope="infra"} - node_boot_time_seconds{scope="infra"})) and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(infra_host_info{scope="infra",type=~"$type"}[24h]))

(100 * (1 - avg by (host) (sum by (host, cpu) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{scope="infra",mode=~"idle|iowait"}[5m]))))) and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(infra_host_info{scope="infra",type=~"$type"}[24h]))

(max by (host) (100 * (1 - ((node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{scope="infra"} + clamp_min(node_zfs_arc_size{scope="infra"} - node_zfs_arc_c_min{scope="infra"}, 0)) or node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{scope="infra"}) / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{scope="infra"}))) and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(infra_host_info{scope="infra",type=~"$type"}[24h]))

(max by (host) ((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{scope="infra"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{scope="infra"}) unless node_filesystem_readonly{scope="infra"} == 1) or 100 * infra_pve_storage_used_bytes{scope="infra"} / infra_pve_storage_size_bytes{scope="infra"})) and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(infra_host_info{scope="infra",type=~"$type"}[24h]))
